name: Home stager

pf.license.need: if: most states license no home staging. Only the business registration and insurance are kept. Where the state's form asks for more, it comes from the state's form.
ask: The business registration, where the state's form asks for one
General liability insurance; cover for the furniture and decor inventory the business rents out
Each stager's own card or number, only where the state's form asks
pf.license.holder: The business. Stagers work under it. Movers, painters, cleaners or repair pros the client hires hold their own licenses.
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
blocks: A home with an unsafe floor, stair or ceiling, or water coming through, is not staged until it is fixed
Repairs, painting, cleaning and moving the owner's own belongings are never booked, quoted or billed as Lee Staging's own
pf.license.renewals: Registration and insurance dates kept; reminded 30 days out; a lapse pauses the work that needs it
pf.license.background: Background checks only where the state's form asks, or where the owner chooses them for staff who enter homes

pf.services.pattern: Consult, then project: a staging project is booked only after a written proposal with a price and a signed agreement. Small fixed jobs book straight from the list.

B.name: In-home staging consult
B.price: $89 (the example business's own price), counted toward the project price if Alex signs; a free first consult is a starting option
B.where: at the home that will be sold; an adult 18 or older (the owner, or the agent for a vacant home) must be there
B.before: a card saved, for the late-cancel or no-show fee
B.after: billed only if no agreement follows; the owner may have the saved card charged at DONE instead

B.name: Whole-home staging package (install, rented furniture and decor for the term, removal)
B.price: quoted after the consult: a written proposal with a flat price within 1 business day, good for 14 days (the example: a $3,200 three-bedroom package with a 60-day term)
B.length: install day about 6 hours; removal day about 4 hours; the term is set by the agreement (the example: 60 days)
B.where: at the home that will be sold
B.before: nothing more at booking; half the project price as a deposit once the agreement is signed
B.after: the rest after the install, on the bill Rosie texts (or the business's own way)

B.name: Staging touch-up visit
B.price: $179, from the list: a lived-in home, declutter and rearrange, up to 2 hours
B.where: at the home that will be sold
B.before: a card saved for the $89 fee

B.name: Photo-day styling visit
B.price: $150, from the list: styling in the hour before the listing photographer, about 90 minutes
B.where: at the home that will be sold

B.name: Vacant room staging, priced from photos
B.price: priced from the customer's photos (the example: $640, a living room and a primary bedroom); over $500, Sam OKs it
B.where: at the home that will be sold
B.before: a signed agreement, then a 25% deposit
B.after: the rest on the bill Rosie texts

B.name: Written staging plan
B.price: $199, ready in 3 business days: a room-by-room plan and declutter list for the owner to follow
B.where: after the consult; the plan goes on the secure page

B.name: Rental extension
B.price: $450 a month (the example), added only with the owner's yes in their own chat, billed after the new removal day; never charged on its own

B.name: Extra staging time
B.where: added to a project for work beyond the agreement, only by a signed change order, never booked alone

B.name: Change order
B.price: an added room: priced, written and signed before the work; added to the final bill

B.name: Furniture and decor
B.price: rented for the term and included in the quoted price; never sold, so Rosfield takes no product money

B.name: Restaging visit
B.price: $150 a visit (the example), booked when the owner asks; each visit is booked and paid like a single one
B.where: at the home that will be sold

A.name: Staging session
A.where: at the staging studio, with a staging advisor
A.before: a card saved for the $20 missed-session fee

A.name: Kids' room session
A.who: booked by the parent, who stays; the child is never the one served

A.name: Virtual staging consult
A.price: $55, 45 minutes, by video (counts as at the studio); credited toward a project if Alex signs

A.name: Whole-home staging plan (layout, furniture list, photo-day plan)
A.before: a card saved for its $40 fee

A.name: Package pick from photos
A.price: priced from the customer's photos (the example: $90); Sam OKs each one

A.name: Staging session at home
A.price: $75, paid in full when booked: a staging advisor brings a style board to the home

A.name: Custom staging plan
A.price: priced at the studio after a $25 consult (the example: $110)

A.name: Intro call
A.price: 15 minutes, free, by phone: a call with a staging advisor before booking; nothing taken and nothing owed

pf.services.capacity: A lead stager and a helper go to every install and removal day, and a day shows only when both are free. The studio's table is saved for each studio booking.
pf.services.skills: Consults and projects: the lead stagers. Studio sessions: the staging advisors. Heavy furniture and stairs: two people.
pf.services.nobody_home: Yes on install and removal days for a vacant home, if the owner (or the listing agent) puts the way in on the secure page; DONE with start and end photos confirms it. The consult always needs an adult there.
pf.services.online: A virtual staging consult by video counts as at the studio; consults and install days are in person
pf.services.smallest_job: A switch the owner sets: the smallest project taken. Smaller requests are offered a staging touch-up visit or a photo-day styling visit instead.

before_times: Which rooms, and is the home empty or lived in?
A house, a condo or an apartment?
When does it go on the market, and when are the listing photos?
after_time: Who owns the home and signs? (an agent may book for the owner, but the owner signs)
How does the crew get in: lockbox, key, or someone home? (codes go on the secure page)
Are the power and water on?
Stairs, an elevator or parking limits for moving furniture
Anything the owner wants kept out of the staging or put away first
pf.questions.who_may_book: The owner of the home, an adult 18 or older, or the listing agent or another adult the owner authorizes. The owner signs the agreement; an agent who pays is the payer.
studio: Which room, and a rough budget (on the secure page)
Photos and rough sizes of the room (optional)

stop.words: a gas smell, sparking or smoking wires, a carbon monoxide alarm
stop.says: Leave now. Then call 911 and the gas or power company.

stop.words: a floor or stair that is soft or sagging, or a ceiling coming down
stop.says: Stay out of that room, and call 911 if anyone is at risk.

stop.words: water coming through a ceiling or wall, or mold across a room
stop.says: Shut off the water at the main if you can. Call a plumber or a mold cleanup company first.
stop.booking: no booking until it is fixed

steps_then_go_on.words: worry about a freshly painted or refinished floor
steps_then_go_on.says: Keep off it until it is dry. The crew lays floor pads, or comes after it cures.
steps_then_go_on.booking: goes on; the install day moves if needed

steps_then_go_on.says: The crew is two people, and large pieces go in through the widest door.

steps_then_go_on.words: pets or small children in a lived-in home
steps_then_go_on.says: Keep them in another room during the install and removal.

pf.safety.business_line: Anything about repairs, mold, pests or whether a floor can carry furniture goes to the owner's licensed pros and the business's own line, never Rosie

pf.first_steps.before_proposal: The staging consult at the home, with the owner there (the agent may join)
after_agreement: The cancel window ends before any delivery, where the state's rules give one
Install day is picked to finish before the listing photos
The owner puts away valuables, papers, medicines and personal photos before install day
The way in (lockbox or key) goes on the secure page before install day
prep: Put away valuables, papers, medicines and personal photos
Clear surfaces and take out trash
Leave parking near the door for the crew
Keep pets in another room during install and removal
Put any lockbox code on the secure page
studio_prep: Bring photos and rough sizes of the rooms
Bring the listing date if you have one

pf.visit.check_in: Consult: the check-in code at the door. Install and removal days: that day's code at the door, or the lockbox and a start photo for a vacant home. Studio: the code at the desk. Video: the code read out at the start.
pf.visit.at_the_visit: The stager walks the rooms, measures the main ones, takes before photos with the owner's OK and notes what the owner wants kept out. A written proposal with a price follows the same day or the next business day, good for 14 days.
pf.visit.changes: Changes after signing are change orders: a new price and a new yes, signed before the added work
pf.visit.outside_checks: None by the stager. Repairs, painting and cleaning belong to the pros the owner hires.
pf.visit.done: The walk-through (with the owner, the agent, or by photo): every room checked against the plan, with any fix list noted, then DONE on install day. Removal day gets its own DONE.
pf.visit.studio_done: DONE after the session, with the notes and picks saved
pf.visit.before_photos: Each room as it is, only with the owner's OK, and never of papers, IDs or people

pf.money.visit: The example's $89 staging consult counts toward the project price if Alex signs, and is billed alone only if no agreement follows. The owner may have the saved card charged at DONE instead of texting the bill. A free first consult is the owner's choice.
pf.money.no_money_before_agreement: On a project, nothing beyond the consult is taken before the agreement is signed
pf.money.deposit: Half the project price once the agreement is signed (the example's own terms), to reserve the furniture for the term. Any cap on money paid before the work comes from the state's form.
pf.money.final: The rest after the install, with any change orders, on the bill Rosie texts (or the business's own way)
pf.money.change_orders: Added to the final bill, as signed
pf.money.rental: Furniture and decor are rented for the term and included in the price; nothing is sold. A rental extension is added only with the owner's yes in their own chat and billed after the new removal day.
pf.money.someone_else_pays: A listing agent may pay: what is due at booking is paid on the page by the person booking; the payer gets a pay link only for the rest and approves nothing; the owner signs the agreement
pf.money.big_bills: Bank transfer through the company's own Stripe, for bills over the owner's amount (the example: $500); paid once it clears. A check also works: the stager texts 'paid check'.
pf.money.late_cancel: Free to cancel until the business's cutoff; later, up to the fee agreed at booking, only if Sam OKs it. A move the business makes is never charged.
pf.money.early_sale: A home that sells early can end the term early; the agreement says what is kept for the days not used
pf.money.kept_apart: Money paid before the work is kept apart only where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form)
pf.money.tips: Off by default. A tip line shows on the bills Rosie texts only if the owner turns it on; Rosie never asks for a tip.
pf.money.tax: Tax on the work follows the state's form
pf.money.studio: Studio sessions: a card saved for the $20 fee, paid at the studio desk. The virtual consult is paid when booked ($55) and counts toward a project if signed.

never_in_texts: The listing price and the budget
Proposals, agreements and change orders (secure page only, with a copy by email)
pf.messages.photos: Room photos only on the secure page, and shown to others only with the owner's OK; never photos of papers, IDs or people
pf.messages.minors: Never booked by a minor; a child at home is never the one who lets the crew in

pf.staff.roles: Lead stagers (Victor, Dev) for consults, install and removal days; staging advisors (Camille, Jonas) at the studio
pf.staff.licenses: No person license unless the state's form asks. Stagers work under the business.
pf.staff.who_oks: Sam OKs proposals and change orders over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins
pf.staff.stand_in: Another stager may take a consult if Alex agrees; a project keeps its lead stager unless Sam moves it
pf.staff.assistants: A helper may carry and place furniture with a lead stager; never signs for the business or handles the owner's valuables

pf.rules.agreement: A written agreement for project work, signed by the owner and the business before any deposit: the rooms, the furniture and decor plan, the install day, the term and removal day, the extension rate, the damage terms, the project price and how it is paid, and the change-order rule
pf.rules.damage: Damage to rented pieces or to the home is handled by the agreement; Sam decides, and the owner's side is told in writing
pf.rules.items_kept_out: Valuables, papers, medicines, firearms and personal photos are put away by the owner before install day; the crew never handles them
pf.rules.agreement_parts: Any parts the state's form lists, like a registration number or the cancel notice for an agreement that began at the home
pf.rules.cancel_window: Where the rules give a cancel window for a sale made at the home, nothing is delivered until it ends
pf.rules.inventory: Staging furniture and decor stay the business's own property; nothing is sold
pf.rules.show: A registration number on the listing, the proposal and the agreement, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.warranty: No guarantee of a sale. A free touch-up visit for a piece placed wrongly within 14 days (the owner's setting)

pf.edges.delivery_late: A piece is late: the install day moves, or the room is staged in two parts; the photo date is checked, with no fee
pf.edges.photo_date_moves: The listing photographer moves the date: the install day moves with it, with no fee
pf.edges.sells_early: The home sells early: removal day moves earlier; the agreement says what is kept for unused days
pf.edges.damaged_piece: A piece is damaged or dented: it goes on the fix list and is swapped from van stock, or the damage terms apply
pf.edges.no_access: The lockbox or key does not work and nobody answers in 15 minutes: the crew leaves; Sam decides about a fee
pf.edges.extension: A month more is added only with the owner's yes and billed after the new removal day
pf.edges.walk_through_dispute: Goes to Sam; the last bill waits
pf.edges.renter: A rented home needs the landlord's OK for any fixed hooks or wall hangings
pf.edges.other: All other edge cases are handled the generic way

Safety: stop words are a gas smell or sparking wires, a soft floor or stair or a falling ceiling, and water through a ceiling or wall or mold across a room (no booking until fixed); steps-then-go-on are a freshly painted or refinished floor, heavy furniture on stairs, and pets or small children in a lived-in home.
